page_title: LEC 0-2 UDI | Lecce v Udinese 13/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' The referee blows his whistle after Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
90+3' Martin Payero (Udinese) misses the target from a promising position, sending the ball well wide of the left post.
90+2' Fabio Cannavaro has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Oier Zarraga (Udinese) replacing Walace.
90+2' It will be a substitution. Joao Ferreira (Udinese) is ready to enter the pitch as Lazar Samardzic walks off.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' A clumsy foul by Marin Pongracic (Lecce) and Davide Massa blows his whistle.
85' 0 - 2 Goal! Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 0:2.
85' Keinan Davis (Udinese) escapes his marker to meet a cross and heads to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent reflex save to deny him.
82' Remi Oudin (Lecce) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
81' Lecce will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
81' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Lecce are awarded a corner kick.

80' Joan Gonzalez (Lecce) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.

78' Federico Baschirotto (Lecce) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the bottom left corner, but Maduka Okoye keeps the ball out.
78' Poor challenge! Walace (Udinese) is penalised for tripping and Davide Massa blows his whistle. Lecce win a free kick.
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Festy Ebosele (Udinese) will replace Kingsley Ehizibue.
73' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) gets inside the box and tries to beat Maduka Okoye with a measured shot into the right side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
72' Substitution. Joan Gonzalez (Lecce) on for Pontus Almqvist.
72' Here is a change. Patrick Dorgu is going off and Luca Gotti gives the last tactical orders to Remi Oudin (Lecce).
71' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) smashes the ball from the edge of the box and misses well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
71' The free kick is delivered by Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
70' Davide Massa blows the whistle, Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) is penalised for a foul. Udinese have a free kick.
67' Fabio Cannavaro has decided to make a change. Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) replaces Isaac Success.
67' The substitution has been made. Keinan Davis (Udinese) has replaced Lorenzo Lucca.

65' Marin Pongracic (Lecce) races through the centre to the edge of the box then lets fly with a rocket of a shot that flies a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
64' Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
62' Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
60' Martin Payero (Udinese) has tested the patience of referee Davide Massa and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
59' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
58' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Udinese get a free kick.
57' Today's referee Davide Massa rightly decides to book Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) for his harsh tackle.
56' Luca Gotti decides to make a substitution. Alexis Blin will be replaced by Santiago Pierotti (Lecce).
56' It's time for a substitution. Medon Berisha (Lecce) comes on in place of Hamza Rafia.
55' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
55' Good movement by Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball is behind the touchline and Lecce will take a throw-in.
54' An attempted cross from Antonino Gallo (Lecce) is cleared.
53' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
53' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Antonino Gallo (Lecce). The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lecce.
51' Martin Payero (Udinese) turns on the edge of the box and immediately fires in a shot at goal, but the keeper can relax as it spins well wide of the left post.
50' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Wladimiro Falcone.
50' Marin Pongracic (Lecce) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. Udinese are awarded a free kick.
49' Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
48' Davide Massa blows his whistle and signals a foul after Isaac Success (Udinese) brought his opponent down.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Davide Massa has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
45+1' Lecce take a short corner kick.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.

45' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
44' Federico Baschirotto (Lecce) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. There is a free kick near the sideline to Udinese.
44' Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
43' Davide Massa blows his whistle after Hassane Kamara (Udinese) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
39' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post.
36' 0 - 1 Goooooal! Martin Payero beats his man and slings in a cross towards Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese), who evades his marker and plants a fine header into the bottom left corner from close in. 0:1.
35' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
33' The corner is swung in but Udinese can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
33' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. It will be a corner kick for Udinese.

31' Nehuen Perez (Udinese) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball miles of the left post. Nice run, but poor finish! The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
29' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) is unable to get the free-kick over the defensive wall from mid-range.
29' Davide Massa blows his whistle for a foul after Martin Payero (Udinese) hacks down one of his opponents. That's a free kick to Lecce.
26' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Davide Massa has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
25' Isaac Success (Udinese) slips past a defender on the edge of the box and hits a shot at goal that rises just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
22' Nehuen Perez (Udinese) has a snap shot at goal from distance after a rebound falls his way, but the effort is wild and flies miles over the bar.
22' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
19' The corner kick picks out Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) free in the box, but his header from close in lacks control and balloons high over the bar.
19' Udinese win a corner.
18' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the free kick from Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) on the edge of the box.
18' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) will take a free kick in a very promising position.
17' Davide Massa shows a yellow card to Alexis Blin (Lecce), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
17' Alexis Blin (Lecce) jumps into a tackle and Davide Massa signals a foul.

13' Alexis Blin (Lecce) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
12' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) will take the corner.
12' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball goes out for a corner. Lecce can continue in their attacking effort.
11' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
11' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) has a shot blocked from inside the box. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lecce.
9' None of the Lecce players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
9' Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession. Lecce have been awarded a corner kick.
7' Nehuen Perez (Udinese) commits a rough challenge and Davide Massa blows his whistle for a foul.
5' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
4' A cross from a corner kick by Lecce is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
4' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play and Lecce have been awarded a corner kick.
3' Lecce work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
3' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The referee signals a corner kick to Lecce.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Udinese will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Davide Massa.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
